Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Lake George hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 7 of the 14 Lake George hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: KAYAK.com at 2, Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2 and momondo.com at 1. These are the Lake George rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 8 of the 11 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: momondo.com at 3, Etrip.net at 2, goseek.com at 2, KAYAK.com at 2, Super.com at 2, the hotel's own site at 2, Vio.com at 2 and Hotelscombined.com at 1 (a tie counts for each site). At the other 3, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: at 1 of the hotels listed below, the all-in prices put the gap on the other side of the 5% line, and the study also counts the 3 named below that are not listed on this page. Taxes and fees at Lake George hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($11 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Skyline by Choice Hotels to 12% at Quality Inn Lake George. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
